news_signals.why: Large government contract win validates the AIP platform thesis and provides durable recurring revenue. Defense AI is the single hottest government spending theme and this win locks in multi-year revenue visibility.

news_signals.why: Coinbase is the primary custodian for multiple Ethereum ETFs and earns fees on every dollar of inflow. Record ETF flows directly translate to Q3 revenue beats when reported in November.

news_signals.headline: Rocket Lab Achieves 50th Successful Electron Launch, Wins $515M Space Force Contract for National Security Missions
news_signals.why: Launch milestone demonstrates operational reliability that large government customers require. $515M Space Force contract provides 3-year revenue visibility and validates RKLB as a serious national security launch provider.

news_signals.headline: IBM Quantum Demonstrates 1000-Qubit Commercial Application, Google Announces Quantum Computing Partnership with Defense Department
news_signals.why: Quantum computing sector news from IBM and Google pulls all quantum names higher due to institutional FOMO rotation. IONQ as the most liquid pure-play quantum stock absorbs most of the sector buying.

news_signals.headline: Fed Governor Signals September Rate Cut 'On the Table' as Inflation Continues Cooling Toward 2% Target
news_signals.why: Upstart's AI lending business directly expands when rates fall - lower rates increase loan origination volumes and reduce default rates simultaneously. Rate cut expectations are the single biggest bullish catalyst for the UPST thesis.
